grammarRule.formula: Subject + didn't (did not) + Base Verb (V1) + Object

explanation.ml: കഴിഞ്ഞകാലത്ത് ഒരു കാര്യം ചെയ്തില്ല എന്ന് പറയാൻ 'didn't' (did not) ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നു. 'didn't' നൊപ്പം എപ്പോഴും ക്രിയയുടെ ആദ്യ രൂപം (V1) മാത്രമേ വരാവൂ (didn't go, didn't see).
explanation.en: Master Negative Past: Didn't + V1 with clear formula: Subject + didn't (did not) + Base Verb (V1) + Object

goldenTip.ml: 💡 ടിപ്പ്: 💡 വലിയ തെറ്റ് ഒഴിവാക്കുക: 'I didn't went' എന്ന് ഒരിക്കലും പറയരുത്! ❌ ശരിയായ രൂപം: ✅ 'I didn't go'. 'didn't' കഴിഞ്ഞാൽ ക്രിയ എപ്പോഴും V1 ആയിരിക്കും.
goldenTip.en: Golden Tip: 💡 വലിയ തെറ്റ് ഒഴിവാക്കുക: 'I didn't went' എന്ന് ഒരിക്കലും പറയരുത്! ❌ ശരിയായ രൂപം: ✅ 'I didn't go'. 'didn't' കഴിഞ്ഞാൽ ക്രിയ എപ്പോഴും V1 ആയിരിക്കും.

traps.question: Select the grammatically correct negative past sentence:
traps.explanation: 'Didn't' must always be followed by the base form V1 ('see'): 'I didn't see him yesterday.'
traps.ruleHint: Negative Past Rule: didn't + base verb (V1).

traps.question: Choose the correct sentence to express that you did not forget the keys:
options: I was not forget the keys.
I did not forgot the keys.
traps.explanation: Base verb 'forget' must be used with 'didn't': 'I didn't forget the keys.'

traps.question: How do you say that they didn't come to the party?
options: They didn't came to the party.
They didn't come to the party.
They was not come to the party.
traps.explanation: Use base verb 'come': 'They didn't come to the party.'
